attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

text.name: Slugma

text.name: Froakie

text.flavor: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

text.name: Clauncher

text.name: Poochyena
text.flavor: NO. 261 Bite Pokémon HT: 1'08" WT: 30.0 lbs. A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

text.name: Mightyena

attacks.name: Hard Bite

text.flavor: NO. 262 Bite Pokémon HT: 3'03" WT: 81.6 lbs. It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

text.name: Inkay
text.flavor: NO. 686 Revolving Pokémon HT: 1'04" WT: 7.7 lbs. Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

text.name: Pawniard
text.flavor: NO. 624 Sharp Blade Pokémon HT: 1'08" WT: 22.5 lbs. Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

text.name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Wicked Jab
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.name: Honedge

attacks.name: Continuous Slash

text.flavor: NO. 679 Sword Pokémon HT: 2'07" WT: 4.4 lbs. Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

text.name: Snubbull

text.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: NO. 210 Fairy Pokémon HT: 4'07" WT: 107.4 lbs. It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

text.name: Swirlix

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

text.name: Farfetch’d

text.name: Snorlax

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Sitdown Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.name: Bunnelby
